evidence_paraphrase: Terraced tell on the southern slope of a ridge between Wadi Samiya and Wadi Siya, c. 2 km E of Kafr Malik; separated from the ridge on the north by a rock-cut moat; south of the tell the abundant spring Ein Samiya. At the foot of the tell on its west side a Byzantine church 14 x 10.5 m with a mosaic floor, repaired in the Crusader period. Adjoining the church on the east a water pool and remains of its roofing vault. C. 300 m east of the path a built aqueduct crosses Wadi Siya, preserved c. 3 m above the stream bed; many water mills and rock-cuttings along the stream. Sherds EB to Crusader.
